name: Dunkin' Crispy Hash Browns (6-Piece Order)
whyItWorks: Shredded potato coins seasoned lightly with sage and white pepper and oven-toasted (not submerged in a deep fryer vat). Lower grease load than standard fast-food hashbrowns.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the 6-piece hash browns warmed. Eat plain with a pinch of salt; avoid ketchup with high-fructose corn syrup if sensitive.
